question: In which of the following countries was the revolutionary Ghadar Party formed?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 3**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Ghadar Party was formed in the United States.
 
• The party was established in 1913 by Indian immigrants, primarily Punjabis, to fight against British rule in India.
 
• The Ghadar Party played a significant role in the Indian independence movement by encouraging revolutionary activities and mobilizing the Indian diaspora.
 
• It published a newspaper called "Ghadar" to spread revolutionary ideas and garner support for the cause of Indian independence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Ghadar Party was founded by leaders like Lala Har Dayal, Sohan Singh Bhakna, and Kartar Singh Sarabha.
 
• The party's headquarters was located in San Francisco, California.
 
• Despite facing numerous challenges, including surveillance and suppression by British intelligence, the Ghadar Party continued to inspire Indian revolutionaries both in India and abroad.
 
• The legacy of the Ghadar Party is remembered for its contribution to the broader struggle for India's independence.
